disclaimer: Statuses come from submitted forms, support tickets, published requirements, and exchange replies.

funding.note: Funds are reserved for the first exchange that approves BTC09 and confirms its current integration, custody, liquidity, withdrawal, delisting, and refund terms.

exchanges.name: Bybit
exchanges.public_note: The form requires a positive listing valuation. BTC09 has no verified public market price, so no value was fabricated.

exchanges.name: Kraken
exchanges.public_note: Requires market-maker, price, audit, custody, and treasury information BTC09 cannot honestly provide yet.

exchanges.name: Coinbase
exchanges.public_note: Requires an issuer entity, address, team identity details, and beneficial-owner information.

exchanges.name: Crypto.com
exchanges.public_note: Requires legal and security review material that is not available yet.

exchanges.name: KuCoin
exchanges.public_note: Requires company records, a legal opinion, and KYC for at least three core team members.

exchanges.name: OKX
exchanges.public_note: Current application requirements do not fit BTC09's fair-launch, no-company structure.

exchanges.name: HTX
exchanges.public_note: Current application requirements do not fit the information and budget available.

exchanges.name: BasicSwap
exchanges.public_note: The no-fee integration path expects chain features BTC09 does not currently implement, including CLTV or CSV and SegWit-style support.

exchanges.name: DEX Screener
exchanges.public_note: DEX Screener indexes supported DEX pools after a real pool and transaction exist. BTC09 is a native chain and has no supported DEX pool.
